'''2023 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP, October–November 2023. [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Timo Dusel]] in the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-10-2023-online-championship-series-playoffs/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' October–November 2023
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1417683 forum]
